verdict.summary: All recorded facts match the customer email, the Policy Schedule and the Veridia contract; the claim was reported within 5 days, C3 glass coverage applies, the required photos and quote were provided, no exclusion or playbook referral rule is triggered, so the staged payment of €270 (€320 minus the €50 C3 deductible) should be approved.
